api
brands/brands.delete.spec.ts
DELETE /brands/{id}
only an admin can delete a brand, and it is then gone

a shopper can open a brand and find it in the brand list

PATCH /brands/{id}
renaming a brand changes only its name
brands/brands.post.spec.ts

a brand is rejected when the name is missing
a brand is rejected when the slug is missing
a brand is rejected when the slug contains spaces
a brand is rejected when the name is longer than 120 characters
a second brand with the same slug is refused
brands/brands.put.spec.ts
PUT /brands/{id}
replacing a brand updates both its name and slug
brands/brands.search.spec.ts
GET /brands/search
a shopper finds a brand by a word in its name
a search that matches nothing returns an empty list
carts/carts.add-item.spec.ts
POST /carts/{id}
a shopper adds a product to the cart
adding a product that is already in the cart adds to its quantity
adding is rejected when the product does not exist
adding is rejected when the quantity is zero

carts/carts.delete.spec.ts
DELETE /carts/{cartId}
a deleted cart, items included, can no longer be opened
deleting a cart that does not exist returns not found
carts/carts.get.spec.ts
GET /carts/{id}
a shopper sees every product in their cart with its quantity
opening a cart that does not exist returns not found
carts/carts.post.spec.ts
POST /carts
a shopper starts a new, empty cart

PUT /carts/{cartId}/product/quantity

a quantity over 99 is rejected
carts/carts.remove-item.spec.ts
DELETE /carts/{cartId}/product/{productId}
removing one product leaves the rest of the cart alone
categories/categories.delete.spec.ts
DELETE /categories/{id}
an admin deletes a category and it can no longer be opened
a category that still has subcategories cannot be deleted
a customer cannot delete a category
categories/categories.get.spec.ts
GET /categories/tree/{id}
a shopper opens a category with its subcategories and finds it in the category list
opening a category that does not exist returns not found
categories/categories.patch.spec.ts
PATCH /categories/{id}
renaming a category changes only its name
taking a slug another category already uses is refused
categories/categories.post.spec.ts
POST /categories
a new top-level category is created and matches the API contract
a subcategory is created under an existing category
a category is rejected when the name is missing
a category is rejected when the slug is missing
a category is rejected when the slug contains spaces
a second category with the same slug is refused
categories/categories.put.spec.ts
PUT /categories/{id}
replacing a category updates its name and slug
categories/categories.search.spec.ts
GET /categories/search
a shopper finds a category by a word in its name
a search that matches nothing returns an empty list
categories/categories.tree.spec.ts
GET /categories/tree
the category tree nests a subcategory under its parent
the full tree only lists top-level categories at its root

GET /invoices/{id}
an admin can open any customer’s invoice
a customer cannot open another customer’s invoice
checkout/invoices.guest.spec.ts
POST /invoices/guest
a shopper without an account checks out as a guest
a guest checkout without an email is rejected
checkout/invoices.list.spec.ts
GET /invoices
a customer’s order history shows their own orders only
checkout/invoices.patch.spec.ts
PATCH /invoices/{id}

GET /invoices/{invoice_number}/download-pdf
downloading a PDF that was never generated asks to try again later
checkout/invoices.post.spec.ts
POST /invoices
a customer checks out their cart and gets an invoice with the right total

a shopper who is not logged in must use guest checkout
checkout/invoices.put.spec.ts
PUT /invoices/{id}
a customer replaces the billing address of their order
checkout/invoices.search.spec.ts
GET /invoices/search
a customer finds their order by a word in the billing street
a customer cannot find another customer’s order
checkout/invoices.status.spec.ts
PUT /invoices/{invoiceId}/status
an admin ships an order and the customer sees it
a status that does not exist is rejected
another customer cannot change the status of my order
checkout/payment.check.spec.ts
POST /payment/check
valid cash on delivery details are accepted
valid bank transfer details are accepted
valid credit card details are accepted
valid buy now, pay later details are accepted

a card payment is rejected when the card has expired
a card payment is rejected when the CVV has letters
favorites/favorites.delete.spec.ts
DELETE /favorites/{id}

another customer cannot remove my favorite
favorites/favorites.get.spec.ts
GET /favorites/{id}
a customer opens one of their favorites
another customer cannot open my favorite
favorites/favorites.list.spec.ts
GET /favorites
a customer only sees their own favorites
favorites/favorites.post.spec.ts
POST /favorites

messages/messages.attach.spec.ts
POST /messages/{id}/attach-file

messages/messages.get.spec.ts
GET /messages/{id}

messages/messages.list.spec.ts
GET /messages

messages/messages.post.spec.ts
POST /messages

messages/messages.reply.spec.ts
POST /messages/{id}/reply

messages/messages.status.spec.ts
PUT /messages/{id}/status

products/images.list.spec.ts
GET /images

DELETE /products/{productId}/specs/{specId}

GET /products/{productId}/specs/{specId}

products/product-specs.list.spec.ts
GET /products/{productId}/specs

products/product-specs.names.spec.ts
GET /product-specs/names

products/product-specs.post.spec.ts
POST /products/{productId}/specs

products/product-specs.put.spec.ts
PUT /products/{productId}/specs/{specId}
changing a spec value keeps its name and unit
products/products.delete.spec.ts
DELETE /products/{id}

products/products.get.spec.ts
GET /products/{id}

products/products.list.spec.ts

products/products.patch.spec.ts

products/products.post.spec.ts

products/products.search.spec.ts
GET /products/search
a shopper finds a product by a word in its name
a search that matches nothing returns an empty page

DELETE /users/{id}

users/users.get.spec.ts

users/users.logout.spec.ts

users/users.me.spec.ts

PUT /users/{id}

users/users.refresh.spec.ts

users/users.search.spec.ts
GET /users/search
